text:
Priya (CSM): Heads up — prepping a short QBR focused on Atum's cost spike. Root ask: what's driving the bulk-index token bursts and which low-friction guardrails we can ship before renewal?
Jordan - FinOps: pulling 30/90/180 day burn and top contributors now. will post a link with slices.
Leo (SE): Observed pattern: they kick off bulk indexing nightly + parallel embed jobs. embedding route + openai-compat routes look hot.
María (Acct Owner): Client says they run a backfill next week for new dataset. we need a safe plan that doesn't break ingestion.
Priya (CSM): Goal for QBR slide: (a) 30/90 trend, (b) top 5 routes by tokens, (c) 2 immediate guardrails + savings estimate.
Jordan - FinOps: running command: `redwood usage export --acct=atum --range=90d --by=route --format=csv`
Jordan - FinOps: posted CSV: https://files.redwood.test/atum-burn-90d.csv
Leo (SE): Proposals: 1) per-route burst token quota (soft throttle + escalation email), 2) scheduled bulk-window with batch size limit + backoff, 3) recommend quantized embedding model and persistent embedding cache.
Priya (CSM): Keep it to two deployable asks for next 30 days. Which two have the fastest ROI?
Jordan - FinOps: Quick calc: if we cap bulk window to 50% concurrency and enable 8-bit embeddings, estimated token spend drops ~35% month-over-month. I'll add a 30/90 projection.
María (Acct Owner): Can we offer them a temporary credits extension if they adopt guardrails by renewal?
Priya (CSM): good incentive. add to negotiation playbook.
Leo (SE): Small snippet to detect bulk indexers in logs (for appendices):
```json
{"route":"/embed","concurrency":32,"batch_size":1024,"trigger":"bulk_index"}
```
Priya (CSM): And capture customer feedback bullet: "unexpected token bursts during nightly indexing, causes latency for real-time chat".
BillingBot: Alert: Atum spent 4.2M tokens in last 24h; threshold breached (daily limit not set).
Jordan - FinOps: Adding recommended thresholds: daily soft cap + emergency cutoff at 150% of daily avg, plus webhook alert to CS. I'll add dollar estimates.
Priya (CSM): Owners: Jordan -> spend trends + projected savings, Leo -> config for per-route quota + sample backoff logic, María -> confirm with customer and negotiate credit incentive. Sync 8:30am PT tomorrow to finalize one-slide QBR.
Leo (SE): I'll draft the guardrail YAML and share a PR: https://git.redwood/ops/guardrails/pull/123
María (Acct Owner): I'll schedule a quick call with their infra lead after my 11am meeting.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — keep replies short in the doc. I'll assemble slide + appendix and post before 8am. :sparkles:
